title: BPTK Rust SD Engine Model
description: JSON schema for System Dynamics models consumed by the bptk_rust_engine. Models are parsed into an expression AST, topologically sorted, and simulated via Euler integration.

graphical_functions.description: Named lookup tables (graphical functions) used by the 'lookup' built-in. Keys are table names referenced in lookup() calls.

stoptime.description: Simulation stop time (inclusive). Must be >= starttime.

entities.description: All model entities grouped by type. At least one entity category should be present.

stocks.description: Stock (level/accumulator) entities. Stocks are integrated via Euler method and are not part of the topological evaluation order.

flows.description: Flow (rate) entities. Flows enforce non-negativity: max(0, value).

converters.description: Converter (auxiliary) entities. Pure algebraic computations with no special constraints.

constants.description: Constant entities. Typically use literal equations but can reference other entities. Can be overridden at runtime via set_constant().

stock.description: A stock (level/accumulator). Integrated each step: stock(t+dt) = stock(t) + dt * net_flow(t).

name.description: Unique entity name used in references.

initial_value.description: Expression evaluated once at t=starttime to set the stock's initial value.

equation.description: Net flow equation. Typically references one or more flows (e.g., inflow - outflow). Defaults to 0 if omitted.

flow_or_converter.description: A flow, converter, or constant entity.

name.description: Unique entity name used in references.

equation.description: The equation that computes this entity's value each timestep.

graphical_function.description: A lookup table (graphical function) for linear interpolation. Points must be sorted by x-coordinate. Values outside the range are clamped to the nearest boundary.

points.description: Array of [x, y] coordinate pairs defining the interpolation curve.

expression.description: An expression AST node. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

expr_literal.description: A literal numeric value, or a string value (used only as a lookup table name argument).

oneOf.description: A lookup table name (only valid as the second argument to the 'lookup' function).

expr_ref.description: A reference to another entity by name. Resolved to an index at parse time.

name.description: The name of the referenced entity. Must match an entity defined in the model.

expr_binary_op.description: A binary operation on two sub-expressions.

expr_unary_op.description: A unary operation on a sub-expression.

expr_call.description: A call to a built-in function.

args.description: Function arguments. Argument count depends on the function.

expr_if.description: A conditional expression. Evaluates 'then' if condition is nonzero (truthy), 'else' otherwise.

condition.description: Condition expression. Nonzero = true, zero = false.

then.description: Expression evaluated when condition is truthy.

else.description: Expression evaluated when condition is falsy.

builtin_function.description: Built-in function name. Each function has a specific argument signature.
